title: Dolphin’s Barn
html_source: Dolphin’s Barn (Irish: An Carnán, meaning “the parcel”) is an inner city suburb of Dublin, Ireland, situated on the Southside of the city in the Dublin 8, and partially in the Dublin 12, postal district. Its name derives from a family named Dolphyn who once owned a storehouse there.
